clue.text: Spades have lodged in the ground

parts.note: S is the card-suit abbreviation for spades
to have something is to own it

explanation.surface: A card player's spades seem to have got stuck in the earth.
explanation.definitionFit: Seeds that are sown have been planted, put into the soil to grow.

clue.text: Earthquake activity exists in half of built-up area

indicators.note: one word sits inside the other, so 'in' signals insertion

parts.note: semi- is the prefix meaning half
is means exists
a city is a large built-up area

explanation.surface: Tremors are being felt in half of a town.
explanation.definitionFit: Seismicity is the frequency and strength of earthquakes in a region.

clue.text: Roll with end of loaf

parts.note: the heel is the crusty end of a loaf

explanation.surface: A bread roll served with the end of a loaf.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Roll' wants to be bread beside the loaf; it is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To wheel is to roll something along, or to turn in a circle.

clue.text: Being spiteful about bridge couple — charming

explanation.walkthrough: In bridge the four players sit as North, South, East and West, and East-West are partners.
explanation.definitionFit: Bewitching describes something enchanting, as if casting a spell, a synonym of charming.

clue.text: Miner and former Conservative mostly drinking wine

indicators.note: the outer pieces swallow the wine, so 'drinking' signals putting it inside

indicators.note: the word loses its last letter, so 'mostly' signals a short tail

parts.note: a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party
cava is Spanish sparkling wine

explanation.surface: A miner and an ex-Tory MP are knocking back wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Miner' looks like a coal miner beside the politician, but it is the definition: anyone or anything that digs out earth.
explanation.definitionFit: An excavator is a digging machine or person, so loosely one who mines the ground.

clue.text: Means of entry during rental period

parts.note: in means during, as in 'in the night'
a let is a period of renting a property

explanation.surface: How to get into a place while renting it.
explanation.definitionFit: An inlet is an opening through which something, such as water or air, enters.

clue.text: Picture educational establishment with convict for member

a leg is a limb, a member of the body

explanation.surface: A school photo showing a convict among its members.
explanation.definitionFit: A collage is a picture made by sticking pieces of paper and other items onto a backing.

clue.text: Trouble means taking in youth with a scooter

clue.text: A delay over celebration

clue.text: Figure university is in bad condition

explanation.definitionFit: A statue is a carved or cast figure of a person or animal.

clue.text: Indistinguishable dialect in broadcast

explanation.definitionFit: Two things that are identical are the same in every respect, so they cannot be told apart.

clue.text: Provider of beer that's less fattening

definitions.meaning: your ... is your neighbourhood pub, which serves beer
read as '...', short for low-calorie food or drink

explanation.surface: A diet-friendly beer supplier.

clue.text: Soviet minister gets second great deal over extracting erbium

Er is the chemical symbol for erbium

clue.text: President's cut, receiving a wound

clue.text: Lavish volume of drink with large kebab, too, ordered

parts.note: L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

clue.text: 100 in clear section of road is perhaps working for many?

clue.text: Strictly routine is one making others go to work on an egg, severally

clue.text: Unfortunately, we'd Irish setters who control all we do
